summary.intent: Resolve all open CodeRabbit review comments on PR #361 by triaging, fixing, and replying to each thread.
summary.outcome: All 3 unresolved threads addressed: strengthened test assertions, tightened auto-heal logic in schema validation, and added a warning log for auto-repair visibility. All tests passed (171/171 core, 69/69 SDK unit), changes committed and pushed.

repo: TypeScript does not propagate type narrowing from called functions back to the caller — explicit casts like `as unknown[]` are required after validation helpers.
The monorepo is structured as packages/core, packages/sdk, and packages/sdk-core with separate test suites; integration tests require a live API and are expected to fail locally.

`resolveIpnsRecord` throws on transient HTTP errors (5xx, network) but returns null only on explicit 404 or API-level not-found responses — auto-repair in bin/index.ts is therefore safe from transient failures.
DTS build must be verified separately from unit tests after schema/type changes.

code.finding: `!response.success` returns null — covers API-level not-found; could include delegated routing errors, which is pre-existing behavior not introduced by this PR.
HTTP 404 returns null; all other non-2xx statuses throw, preventing auto-repair from firing on transient failures.
Auto-heal scope was narrowed: only empty `ipHash` fields are auto-healed; other malformed values now cause rejection instead of silent repair.
Round-trip assertions were strengthened per CodeRabbit feedback.

workflow: CodeRabbit concerns about data loss on transient failures warrant investigation of the underlying error-handling contract before dismissing — in this case the throw-vs-null distinction in resolveIpnsRecord resolved the concern.
Reply to each PR review thread with specific file:line references before resolving via GraphQL mutation; REST endpoint requires integer `in_reply_to` using `--field`, not `-f`.

friction: TypeScript's lack of caller-side narrowing propagation from validation helpers requires manual casts, which are easy to miss and not flagged until CI runs.
Integration tests fail locally whenever the API is not running, creating noise that must be mentally filtered when evaluating test results.
open_items: The `!response.success` path in `resolveIpnsRecord` (line 176) may conflate delegated-routing errors with genuine not-found responses — pre-existing behavior, not investigated in this session.
Auto-repair visibility improvement (warning log) was added, but no alerting or metrics exist for how often auto-repair fires in production.
